author: HyperNatorMC
body:
First, I really don't like HyperNatorMC at all (no offense to my bro who chose it) I mean it sounds like a maniac machine who has no brain and doesn't really make sense. BUT, when Minecraft 1.8+ comes I would be really glad to change the name HyperNatorMC into  something that represents me (and also changing the skin, it really doesn't look like me).
   For some of you who DO want to know what i'm changing it to i'll just give you a Tiny hint:
G - - - - - n - -  :sorry if the - is considered spam. :/

Well I gave you a (little) hint What i'm changing my name.

Now for you,

  • Be appropriate on what you say or else I will request a Lock.
